data.title: City Life
data.setting: Two friends meet on a park bench to talk about living in the city and the village.

lines.speaker: Oliver
lines.text: Hi Luke. Do you like living in this city?

lines.speaker: Luke
lines.text: Hi Oliver. Yes, I do. But my hometown is quieter than this place.

lines.speaker: Oliver
lines.text: Is the village cleaner too?

lines.speaker: Luke
lines.text: Yes, it is. The air is very clean there. And food is cheaper than here.

lines.speaker: Oliver
lines.text: That sounds nice. But this city is bigger than your village.

lines.speaker: Luke
lines.text: That is true. And life in the city is more interesting for me.

lines.speaker: Oliver
lines.text: Why is that?

lines.speaker: Luke
lines.text: There are five cinemas and many parks. My village has only one store.

lines.speaker: Oliver
lines.text: I see. City life is better for shopping, but village life is nicer for rest.

lines.speaker: Luke
lines.text: Exactly. Apartments here are more expensive than houses in the village, though.
